sentences.en: And the Sackett and Wilhelms printing company in Brooklyn has a problem.
sentences.zh: 布鲁克林的萨克特与威廉姆斯印刷公司遇到了一个难题。
说话的是制片人埃米特·菲茨杰拉德。

sentences.en: They're trying to print the popular humor magazine, Judge.
sentences.zh: 他们当时正试图印刷一本受欢迎的幽默杂志《法官》。

sentences.en: And it's really hot and there's a lot of humidity and they're having trouble
sentences.zh: 天气非常炎热，湿度也很高，他们遇到了麻烦，

sentences.en: getting the inks to set properly on the page.
sentences.zh: 油墨无法在纸张上正常固化。

sentences.en: This is writer Stephen Johnson, author of the book How We Got to Now.
sentences.zh: 这是作家斯蒂芬·约翰逊，他是《我们是如何走到今天的》一书的作者。

sentences.en: He says the problem isn't so much the heat, but the moisture in the air,
sentences.zh: 他说问题不在于高温，而在于空气中的水分，

sentences.en: which was warping the paper and throwing the print out of alignment.
sentences.zh: 这导致纸张变形，印刷错位。

sentences.en: And so they hire a young enterprising engineer by the name of Willis Carrier
sentences.zh: 于是他们聘请了一位年轻且富有进取心的工程师，名叫威利斯·开利，

sentences.en: to solve this problem and basically pull the moisture out of the air inside the printing plant.
sentences.zh: 来解决这个问题，从根本上把印刷厂内的空气水分抽走。

sentences.en: And Carrier develops a system that pumps air over cold metal coils.
sentences.zh: 开利开发了一套系统，将空气泵过冰冷的金属盘管。

sentences.en: It pulls the moisture out of the air and the magazines are printed more efficiently
sentences.zh: 它把空气中的水分抽干，杂志印刷得更高效了，

sentences.en: But it has the side effect of as it's pulling the moisture out of the air,
sentences.zh: 但它产生了一个副作用，在抽走空气中水分的同时，

sentences.en: it also makes the air cooler.
sentences.zh: 它也让空气变得凉爽了。

sentences.en: Everybody wants to have lunch in the room with his new machine.
sentences.zh: 大家都想在有他那台新机器的房间里吃午饭。

sentences.en: Everybody's like, well, this is so nice in here.
sentences.zh: 每个人都觉得，这里真是太舒服了。

sentences.en: I'm going to bring my sandwich and sit next to the printing press
sentences.zh: 我要带上三明治，坐在印刷机旁边，

sentences.en: because the air is so much more pleasant.
sentences.zh: 因为这里的空气实在太宜人了。

sentences.en: And he began to think that maybe his new technology could do more than just keep paper dry.
sentences.zh: 他开始思考，也许他的新技术不仅仅能保持纸张干燥。

sentences.en: Maybe it's something that could actually be harnessed in the service of just human comfort.
sentences.zh: 也许它真的可以被利用来服务于人类的舒适感。

sentences.en: He first installs his system in textile factories, tobacco plants,
sentences.zh: 他首先将系统安装在纺织厂、烟草厂，

sentences.en: and other industrial workplaces that required low humidity levels.
sentences.zh: 以及其他需要低湿度的工业场所。

sentences.en: But his invention really catches on in a very different kind of place.
sentences.zh: 但他的发明真正流行起来是在一个完全不同的地方。

sentences.en: So before air conditioning, the last place you would want to go in the summer
sentences.zh: 在空调出现之前，夏天你最不想去的地方，

sentences.en: was to crowd into a movie theater with a thousand other human beings on a day when it was 95 degrees out, right?
sentences.zh: 就是在气温高达95华氏度（约35摄氏度）的日子里，和一千个人挤在电影院里，对吧？

sentences.en: That would just be completely intolerable.
And movie theaters really struggled to sell tickets during the summer months.
sentences.zh: 电影院在夏季确实很难卖出票。

sentences.en: So Carrier approaches a bunch of theater owners all around the country with an idea.
sentences.zh: 于是开利带着一个想法找到了全国各地的影院老板。

sentences.en: I'll install a new machine that turns your place of business into a crisp, cool oasis.
sentences.zh: 我来安装一台新机器，把你们的营业场所变成一片清凉的绿洲。

sentences.en: It won't be cheap, but you'll make up for the cost in summer ticket sales.
sentences.zh: 这不便宜，但你们能通过夏季的票房收入赚回成本。

sentences.en: Theater owners advertised their chilled air, and people came out to air-conditioned theaters in droves.
sentences.zh: 影院老板们宣传他们的冷气，人们蜂拥而至来到有空调的电影院。

sentences.en: Yes, you lucky people, just sit back for a moment, relax,
sentences.zh: 没错，幸运的观众们，请坐下来，放松一下，

sentences.en: and notice the delightfully clean, cool, and refreshing atmosphere
sentences.zh: 感受一下这科学空调影院里，
令人愉悦、洁净、凉爽且清新的环境。

sentences.en: This advertisement from the 1940s shows a bunch of theatergoers wearing fur parkas
sentences.zh: 这则20世纪40年代的广告展示了一群穿着皮大衣的观众，

sentences.en: and icicles dripping from the ceiling.
Suddenly, movies went from being the last place you'd want to be on a summer day
sentences.zh: 突然间，电影院从夏天最不想去的地方，

sentences.en: to being actually one of the nicest places to be.
sentences.zh: 变成了实际上最舒适的地方之一。

sentences.en: And this whole tradition of having these big movies that come out in the summer became possible.
sentences.zh: 而这种在夏天上映大片的传统也因此成为可能。

sentences.en: But air conditioning would do a lot more than just create the summer blockbuster.
sentences.zh: 但空调的作用远不止创造暑期大片。

sentences.en: It would dramatically change where people in the United States lived
sentences.zh: 它彻底改变了美国人的居住地，

sentences.en: and the design of our buildings and homes.
sentences.zh: 以及我们的建筑和住宅设计。

sentences.en: But the air conditioning revolution didn't happen all at once.
sentences.zh: 但空调革命并非一蹴而就。

sentences.en: Before World War II, a few wealthy elites had air conditioning systems installed in their mansions,
sentences.zh: 二战前，少数富豪在豪宅里安装了空调系统，

sentences.en: but mechanically chilled air was still seen as a luxury,
sentences.zh: 但机械制冷在当时仍被视为一种奢侈品，

sentences.en: something to be enjoyed at the theater, but certainly not in your own home.
sentences.zh: 是电影院里享受的东西，绝非家里能有的。

sentences.en: But Willis Carrier wanted to change that.
sentences.zh: 但威利斯·开利想改变这一点。
在1929年的一次演讲中，他说：

sentences.en: air conditioning and cooling for summer may become a necessity rather than a luxury,
sentences.zh: 夏季的空调和制冷可能会成为必需品，而非奢侈品，

sentences.en: and we will look upon present times as marking the end of that dark age
sentences.zh: 我们将把当下视为那个黑暗时代的终结，

sentences.en: in which there was but relatively little cooling for human comfort.
sentences.zh: 在那个时代，为了人类舒适而进行的制冷还相对较少。

sentences.en: The big transformation for air conditioning that really arrives after World War II
sentences.zh: 空调真正的大变革是在二战后到来的，

sentences.en: is, like so many stories of technology,
sentences.zh: 就像许多技术故事一样，
这其实是一个关于小型化的故事，

sentences.en: of taking something that was really big and shrinking it down.

sentences.zh: 早期的空调系统非常巨大，

sentences.en: way too big for an individual home.
sentences.zh: 对于普通家庭来说太大了。

sentences.en: Carrier and other companies were selling air conditioners that could fit in your window.
sentences.zh: 开利和其他公司开始销售可以安装在窗户上的空调。

sentences.en: and it wasn't clear at first that people would buy them.
sentences.zh: 起初人们并不确定是否会购买。

sentences.en: I think advertising played a huge role
sentences.zh: 我认为广告发挥了巨大的作用，

sentences.en: in the increased use of air conditioning in the residential sector.
sentences.zh: 推动了空调在住宅领域的普及。

sentences.en: And what's really interesting is that
the advertising really played on the role of women and their social status.
sentences.zh: 广告确实利用了女性的角色和社会地位。

sentences.en: She is an architecture professor at the UC Berkeley College of Environmental Design
sentences.zh: 她是加州大学伯克利分校环境设计学院的建筑学教授，

sentences.en: and an expert on thermal comfort.
sentences.zh: 也是热舒适度方面的专家。

sentences.en: So if you look at the advertising in the 1950s,
sentences.zh: 如果你看看20世纪50年代的广告，

sentences.en: a lot of them showed women dressed like Beaver Cleaver's mom
sentences.zh: 很多广告里展示的女性穿着像《天才老爸》里的妈妈那样，

sentences.en: with the pearls and the gloved hands and dressed well.
sentences.zh: 戴着珍珠项链，戴着手套，打扮得体。

sentences.en: And it was really trying to associate social status with air conditioning,
sentences.zh: 它确实试图将社会地位与空调联系起来，

sentences.en: that if you have air conditioning, you can live this life of leisure
sentences.zh: 如果你有空调，你就能过上这种悠闲的生活，

sentences.en: and you wouldn't have to sweat with the toil of housework.
sentences.zh: 而不必在繁重的家务中挥汗如雨。

sentences.en: These ads also played on the idea that with air conditioning,
sentences.zh: 这些广告还利用了这样一个理念：有了空调，

sentences.en: homeowners could take control over nature.
The desert, 110 by day, cool enough to need heat the same night.
sentences.zh: 沙漠，白天110华氏度（约43摄氏度），晚上凉爽到需要供暖。

sentences.en: Here's an air conditioning commercial from the early 1960s that takes place in Palm Springs.
sentences.zh: 这是一则20世纪60年代初的空调广告，拍摄地点在棕榈泉。

sentences.en: The maximum test for air conditioning.
Let's ask the owner of this desert show place, Miss Dinah Shore.
sentences.zh: 让我们问问这位沙漠豪宅的主人，黛娜·肖尔小姐。

sentences.en: Hi, with my year-round gas air conditioning by Arcla,
sentences.zh: 嗨，有了Arcla的全年燃气空调，

sentences.en: I just touched the thermostat for delightful cooling or comfortable heat in every room.
sentences.zh: 我只需触碰恒温器，每个房间就能享受凉爽或舒适的暖气。

sentences.en: Humidity controlled, dust and pollen filtered.
sentences.zh: 湿度可控，灰尘和花粉被过滤。

sentences.en: My indoor climate is always perfect.
sentences.zh: 我的室内气候总是完美的。

sentences.en: It was very compelling, the advertising,
sentences.zh: 这些广告非常有说服力，

sentences.en: and I think that really played on people adopting air conditioning more into the home.
sentences.zh: 我认为这确实促使人们更多地在家里安装空调。

sentences.en: In 1960, 13% of homes in the United States had AC.

sentences.zh: 到1980年，这一比例上升到了55%。

sentences.en: In just a few decades, air conditioning went from luxury to necessity,
sentences.zh: 在短短几十年里，空调从奢侈品变成了必需品，
正如威利斯·开利所预言的那样。

sentences.en: The ubiquity of AC has had a serious impact on how,
sentences.zh: 空调的普及对我们的生活方式产生了严重影响，

sentences.en: and maybe most profoundly, where we live.
sentences.zh: 或许最深远的影响是，它改变了我们的居住地。

sentences.en: All of a sudden, there are parts of the United States that had historically been really unpleasant to live in,
sentences.zh: 突然之间，美国有些地区历史上一直非常不适合居住，

sentences.en: that suddenly, because of these home air conditioning units,
sentences.zh: 现在因为有了这些家用空调机，

sentences.en: are now actually delightful places to live.
sentences.zh: 实际上变成了令人愉悦的居住地。

sentences.en: The population of states like Arizona and Florida exploded.
sentences.zh: 亚利桑那州和佛罗里达州等州的人口爆炸式增长。

sentences.en: So in that period after the introduction of home air conditioning,
sentences.zh: 因此，在家用空调引入后的那段时间里，

sentences.en: there is really arguably one of the largest migrations of people in the history of the United States,
sentences.zh: 可以说发生了美国历史上最大规模的人口迁移之一，

sentences.en: moving from the north to the south, to what we now call the Sun Belt.
sentences.zh: 从北方迁往南方，迁往我们现在所说的“阳光地带”。

sentences.en: If you could air condition your way through the summer,
sentences.zh: 如果你能靠空调度过夏天，

sentences.en: then living in the middle of a desert or a humid swamp was no big deal.
sentences.zh: 那么住在沙漠或潮湿的沼泽地里就没什么大不了的了。

sentences.en: In just 10 years, Tucson went from 45,000 people to 210,000 people.
sentences.zh: 在短短10年内，图森市的人口从4.5万增加到了21万。

sentences.en: In the same decade, Houston almost doubled its population.
sentences.zh: 在同一个十年里，休斯敦的人口几乎翻了一番。

sentences.en: And Florida, during, you know, kind of the 1920s, had only a million people living there.
sentences.zh: 而佛罗里达州，在20世纪20年代，只有一百万人居住在那里。

sentences.en: But 50 years later, there were nearly 7 million people in Florida.
sentences.zh: 但50年后，佛罗里达州的人口接近700万。

sentences.en: This mass migration was so significant, it changed the political map.
sentences.zh: 这种大规模迁移意义重大，它改变了政治版图。

sentences.en: Increased populations meant states like Florida got more votes than the Electoral College.
sentences.zh: 人口增加意味着像佛罗里达这样的州在选举人团中获得了更多的选票。

sentences.en: And since a lot of these New Southward migrants were conservative retirees,
sentences.zh: 而且由于许多这些迁往南方的新移民是保守派退休人员，
他们倾向于投票给共和党。

sentences.en: You begin to build this kind of Republican sunbelt coalition that didn't exist before.
sentences.zh: 你开始建立起这种以前不存在的共和党阳光地带联盟。

sentences.en: And that coalition is really crucial to Reagan's successful bid for the presidency in 1980.
sentences.zh: 而这个联盟对里根在1980年成功竞选总统至关重要。

sentences.en: There were obviously a lot of different factors that led to Reagan's election.
sentences.zh: 显然，导致里根当选的因素有很多。

sentences.en: But I think that had air conditioning not been invented,
sentences.zh: 但我认为，如果空调没有被发明出来，

sentences.en: Reagan might still have gotten elected,
but he would have required a different political coalition to make it possible.
sentences.zh: 但他需要一个不同的政治联盟才能实现这一目标。

sentences.en: The population of the Sun Belt boomed with the advent of air conditioning.
sentences.zh: 随着空调的出现，阳光地带的人口蓬勃发展。

sentences.en: But it's not as if no one lived in these places before AC.
sentences.zh: 但这并不是说在空调出现之前没有人住在这些地方。

sentences.en: And those who did had developed lots of strategies to beat the heat,
sentences.zh: 那些住在这里的人已经发展出了许多应对酷暑的策略，

sentences.en: including forms of vernacular architecture that were carefully attuned to the climate.
sentences.zh: 包括精心适应气候的本土建筑形式。

sentences.en: Vernacular refers to traditional architecture that develops in a particular place.
sentences.zh: 本土建筑是指在特定地区发展起来的传统建筑。

sentences.en: And it's often driven by local environmental conditions.
sentences.zh: 它通常由当地的环境条件所驱动。

sentences.en: So if you look at traditional buildings in hot climates,
sentences.zh: 所以如果你看看炎热气候下的传统建筑，

sentences.en: so many of the elements are going to be different if you're in a hot, dry or a hot, humid climate.
sentences.zh: 如果你身处炎热干燥或炎热潮湿的气候，许多建筑元素都会有所不同。

sentences.en: In the desert southwest, houses were traditionally built with
sentences.zh: 在沙漠西南部，房屋传统上是用

sentences.en: hefty materials like adobe and stone that can absorb heat.
sentences.zh: 像土坯和石头这样厚重的材料建造的，可以吸收热量。

sentences.en: You're soaking up the heat during the day,
and then releasing it to the colder air at night.
sentences.zh: 然后在晚上将其释放到较冷的空气中。

sentences.en: Homes in the southwest also tended to have flat roofs
sentences.zh: 西南地区的住宅也倾向于有平屋顶

sentences.en: and small windows that could be closed up during the day
sentences.zh: 和小窗户，白天可以关上，

sentences.en: and opened at night to let the cool air in.
sentences.zh: 晚上打开让凉爽的空气进来。

sentences.en: the vernacular architecture tried to maximize shade and air movement.
sentences.zh: 本土建筑试图最大限度地利用遮阳和空气流动。

sentences.en: There were screened-in sleeping porches, breezeways between rooms,
sentences.zh: 那里有带纱窗的睡眠门廊、房间之间的穿堂风，

sentences.en: and cupolas in the roof to draw cool air up through the house.
sentences.zh: 以及屋顶上的通风塔，将凉爽的空气向上吸入整个房子。

sentences.en: You tend to have much larger windows,
sentences.zh: 你往往会有更大的窗户，

sentences.en: so the entire facade could be opened up.
sentences.zh: 这样整个外立面都可以打开。

sentences.en: You might have much larger shaded porches and balconies,
sentences.zh: 你可能会有更大的遮阳门廊和阳台，

sentences.en: so there's a lot of outdoor living.
sentences.zh: 所以会有很多户外生活空间。

sentences.en: And so you can look at the architecture,
and it says something about the place.
sentences.zh: 它们诉说着关于这个地方的故事。

sentences.en: On-demand cold air freed architects from the challenge of designing a home
sentences.zh: 按需提供的冷气将建筑师从设计挑战中解放出来，

sentences.en: that was uniquely suited to the climate around it.
sentences.zh: 无需再专门设计出适应当地气候的住宅。

sentences.en: And as we got more mechanical systems
sentences.zh: 随着我们拥有了更多的机械系统，

sentences.en: and the power to heat and cool buildings through mechanical systems,
sentences.zh: 以及通过机械系统为建筑物供暖和制冷的能力，

sentences.en: I think architects started relinquishing control
sentences.zh: 我认为建筑师开始将环境调节的控制权

sentences.en: of environmental conditioning to the engineers.
but home builders made up for the cost
sentences.zh: 但房屋建筑商通过削减

sentences.en: by cutting down on passive cooling features.
sentences.zh: 被动式制冷功能来抵消成本。

sentences.en: the local architectural traditions rooted in the climate
sentences.zh: 扎根于当地气候的建筑传统

sentences.en: gave way to tightly sealed, mass-produced tract homes.
sentences.zh: 让位于密封严实、批量生产的预制住宅。

sentences.en: So a house in the southwest
might look the same as a house in New Orleans,
sentences.zh: 可能看起来和新奥尔良的房子一样，

sentences.en: which might look the same as a house in Minnesota.
sentences.zh: 也可能和明尼苏达州的房子一样。

sentences.en: And whether you were in a hot, humid, hot, dry, or cold climate,
sentences.zh: 无论你身处炎热潮湿、炎热干燥还是寒冷的气候中，

sentences.en: I think architecture really lost a sense of place.
sentences.zh: 我认为建筑确实失去了地方感。

sentences.en: The rise of tract housing had to do with more than just air conditioning.
sentences.zh: 预制住宅的兴起不仅仅与空调有关。

sentences.en: It was influenced by the development of the highway system
sentences.zh: 它还受到高速公路系统发展

sentences.en: and the suburbanization of American life.
sentences.zh: 以及美国生活郊区化的影响。

sentences.en: But AC enabled the mass production of affordable homes
sentences.zh: 但空调确实促成了经济适用房的批量生产，

sentences.en: that could exist in many different climate zones.
sentences.zh: 使其能够存在于许多不同的气候带中。

sentences.en: Air conditioning didn't just change residential architecture.
sentences.zh: 空调改变的不仅仅是住宅建筑。

sentences.en: It revolutionized the design of skyscrapers,
sentences.zh: 它彻底改变了摩天大楼、

sentences.en: Before air conditioning, the only source of cool air was the outdoors.
sentences.zh: 在空调出现之前，凉爽空气的唯一来源是户外。

sentences.en: And so offices usually had high ceilings
sentences.zh: 因此，办公室通常有很高的天花板

sentences.en: and lots of windows that people could open.
sentences.zh: 和许多可以打开的窗户。

sentences.en: And so all offices had at least one wall
sentences.zh: 所以所有的办公室至少有一面墙

sentences.en: that was exposed to the perimeter.
You might have court guards in the center of buildings
sentences.zh: 你可能会在建筑物中心设置内庭院，

sentences.en: so that even the spaces that weren't on the street
sentences.zh: 这样即使是不临街的空间

sentences.en: would have access to the air and light on the inside.
sentences.zh: 也能获得内部的空气和光线。

sentences.en: If you look at the floor plans of many mid-rise buildings
sentences.zh: 如果你看看20世纪初许多中层建筑的
